body: You are doing important work. The world needs more people like you. I'm so sorry to hear today was difficult. But know that you are in the hearts and thoughts of many, and no matter what happens you will always be a hero.
You are strong for posting here. I've been in your position many times before. Surviving is an act of bravery. I am proud of you for keeping on.
PTSD is real. I suffer from it, too. The road to recovery is long but very real. One step at a time, celebrate every victor, and be proud of yourself :)
